industry: Gene therapy and AAV vector engineering
summary: Företag 16 develops engineered adeno-associated virus (AAV) vectors for gene therapy applications. The company focuses on designing and screening next-generation capsids with improved tissue targeting, delivery efficiency and therapeutic performance.
target_market: Global gene therapy and advanced therapeutics market
strategy_notes: Focused on partnering with biotech and pharmaceutical companies to commercialize proprietary AAV capsid engineering and screening capabilities for gene therapy programs.
technology_notes: The company uses rational capsid design, DNA barcoding, high-throughput screening and next-generation sequencing to develop AAV vectors with targeted tissue tropism and improved delivery characteristics.
risk_notes: Dependent on successful validation of gene therapy technologies, partnership development, regulatory developments, funding access and competition from established gene delivery platform providers.
